entries.reason: Same test (256): a RETURN that succeeds ends the task, so the arm where RESP is NORMAL is never executed.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after `RETURN TRANSID('OCAC') COMMAREA(WS-COMM-AREA) LENGTH(32)` (247-251): RETURN never comes back on success, so the test runs only when RETURN itself fails, and IBM documents no RESP for it with a 32-byte COMMAREA and an installed TRANSID.
ACCTYPL > 0 is the fall-through of the test at 459, which rejects ACCTYPL < 1 and GO TOs ED999, so the length is always positive here.

The re-count starts at INTRTI(WS-NUM-COUNT-POINT:INTRTL) with WS-NUM-COUNT-POINT = characters before the point + 2, i.e. past the only point (the point count is exactly 1 here), so INSPECT ... AFTER '.' finds no point and tallies 0; a count above 2 is never reached.
OVERDRI NOT NUMERIC after BIF DEEDIT: the digit tally at 701 rejects any overdraft field holding a non-digit (OVERDRL > tally), and DEEDIT of an all-digit field leaves it numeric.
CUSTNOL < 1 is rejected at 437 and ACCTYPL < 1 at 459 (both GO TO ED999), so neither can be true here.
CREACC sets a fail code on every 'N' return, and every code it sets has its own WHEN, so OTHER is never reached.
WHEN '2': CREACC sets only fail codes '1', '3', '5', '7', '8', '9' and 'A' (318-1224); it never sets '2'.
WHEN '4': CREACC sets only fail codes '1', '3', '5', '7', '8', '9' and 'A' (318-1224); it never sets '4'.
WHEN '6': CREACC sets only fail codes '1', '3', '5', '7', '8', '9' and 'A' (318-1224); it never sets '6'.
WHEN 'A' (CREACC account type not one of ISA, MORTGAGE, SAVING, CURRENT, LOAN): BNK1CAC accepts only those types in ED010 (474) and normalises them, so CREACC's type check always passes.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY` tests the 88 on the flag value '2' (line 50), set by no statement: only `SET SEND-ERASE` and `SET SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` (172, 228, 340) write the flag.
The RESP test inside the `IF SEND-DATAONLY` block (1039), which is never entered.
The RESP test inside the `IF SEND-DATAONLY` block (1039), which is never entered.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` is reached only with the flag '3': '1' (SEND-ERASE) leaves SM010 after the first SEND MAP and '2' is never set (see 1039), so the test is always true.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after the SEND TEXT ERASE FREEKB that writes the termination message (1200-1206): IBM raises no condition for it on a terminal that just sent a map, and no fault can be injected on it.
